desc:
Ms. Haley's going out of town for the night. All you have to do is watch her dog.

Princess is a good boy. Throw the ball, give him a bath, fill him bowl, maybe watch some TV. Easy money.

Then the power goes out.

Princess isn't in the house anymore. You'll find him in the backyard. You'll wish you hadn't.

- Hide in closets, but don't let him see you get in
- Set trip wires, fire the net gun, throw a steak to buy yourself a few seconds
- Find the keys, get the doors open, get out to the street
- Play solo or bring up to 3 friends. Everyone gets 3 hearts. Lose them all and you're spectating

Headphones recommended.
